data.description: What if we could save the fishing industry and protect the ocean at the same time? Marine ecologist Enric Sala shares his bold plan to safeguard the high seas -- some of the last wild places on earth, which fall outside the jurisdiction of any single country -- by creating a giant marine reserve that covers two-thirds of the world's ocean. By protecting the high seas, Sala believes we will restore the ecological, economic and social benefits of the ocean. "When we can align economic needs with conservation, miracles can happen," Sala says.

data.title: Chrome 21 arrives with new API for video and audio communication | Omid Farhang
data.description: h-online: With the release of Chrome 21, web applications can now directly access the local system's built-in camera and microphone. Instead of requiring a special plugin, the major stable update to the WebKit-based web browser includes a new HTML5 getUserMedia API - currently a W3C Editor's Draft - to provide web apps with access to the camera and microphone. For security purposes, users will be prompted to grant apps permission to access the hardware.
